tools.name: get_course_summary
tools.description: What ShipReal is, who it is for, and who it is not for. Returns the markdown twin of this page, which carries the full fit guidance.

tools.name: get_enrollment_link
tools.description: Return the ShipReal checkout link and the total for a plan, a seat count and a billing country, without opening anything. Use to answer "what would N seats cost and where do we pay"; the visitor still presses the button to buy.

plan.description: complete is the single course, teams is per seat on one invoice.

seats.description: Seat count for the teams plan. Ignored for complete.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code the buyer pays from, e.g. IL or US. Omit to use this visitor's own country.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Current ShipReal plans and prices for the visitor's billing region, read from the live pricing table on this page.

tools.name: list_curriculum
tools.description: List the ShipReal course curriculum: every part and the modules inside it, as shown on this page.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Open the ShipReal checkout for the Complete course, routed to the right payment provider for the visitor's country. Opens a hosted payment overlay; it does not complete a purchase.

tools.name: start_seat_checkout
tools.description: Open the ShipReal per-seat checkout for teams, routed to the right payment provider for the visitor's country. Opens a hosted payment overlay; it does not complete a purchase.
